name: BSP_TextureAtlas_SplitNameMatches
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = requested descriptor string, EDX = candidate string), AL result; called only from 00af0060 at 00af02dd. Lowercases both sides (004bcc00) and replaces backslash with forward slash (004cad40, constants 00ce7894 and 00ce7898). True on exact case-insensitive equality; false when the candidate is shorter; requires rfind('/') to return the same index on both sides and the directory text to match; requires both names to end in .ats (00d5d23c); otherwise returns equals_ci(stem(request) + '_' (00ce7890), candidate.substr(0, len(request)-3)), both spans measured from the request. One request therefore loads every <stem>_*.ats sibling: the installation has no interface/textures/common.ats but four common_*.ats parts. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_WORLD_EFFECTS.md; reports/app_init_world_effects.json.
